title: An Invoices import file with the old column names imports like a new one
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions, including Settings → Data Import) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Import file {File-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154724-new.csv) is made from the Invoices import template with one Labor row for customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154724-new Fleet), invoice number {Invoice-number-A} (for example ZZWW-724-A), *Line Title value (for example Replace tie rod) and Line Description value (for example excessive play); its headers are the template's new names.
  • Import file {File-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154724-old.csv) is the same as {File-A} except the invoice number is {Invoice-number-B} (for example ZZWW-724-B) and the two headers read the old names "*Line Title - What are you doing" and "Line Description - Why are you doing it".
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings and, under Data Import, click Invoices.
  2. Upload {File-A} and start the import.
  3. Read the import result message.
  4. Upload {File-B} and start the import.
  5. Read the import result message.
  6. Open the imported invoice {Invoice-number-A} and read its line title and description.
  7. Open the imported invoice {Invoice-number-B} and read its line title and description.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: {File-A} imports with no error.
  • Step 5: {File-B} imports with no error, and no message says a column is missing or should be removed.
  • Step 6: the title and description read as written in the file (for example Replace tie rod and excessive play).
  • Step 7: the title and description are exactly the same as in step 6: the old names were read as the same two columns.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10133 (Story 4, The Imports); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S4-R3, S4-R5, read 13 Oct 2026; no design board exists for this story (tech plan: Story 2 and Story 4 are text-only), labels from the Jira story and tech plan; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-016 and Phase 2 tests; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R3: “The importer accepts the old column names as well as the new ones. A file carrying either spelling validates and imports identically.”
  • S4-R5: “The old name is accepted as the column it became: it is neither reported missing nor reported as a column to remove.”
  • SV-10133 acceptance criteria: “Given a historical invoice import file using either spelling of the two columns, then it validates and imports.”
  • Tech plan Phase 2 tests: “legacy headers → imports identically (same lines, titles, descriptions as the new-header file)”
